SCH-23-030C-626 Schlage Satin Chrome Conventional I/C Core

text.description_html:
Schlage Conventional "C" Keyway I/C Core

Full sized large format interchangeable core (LFIC). Comes standard 1 Bitted (code 111111) for onsite keying, or available keyed alike or keyed different that includes 1 key per cylinder. Additional cylinder keys and control keys sold separately.

For use with all locks that use a Schlage LFIC core including KABA 1021 Simplex Keypad Entry Lock, KABA 1041 Simplex Keypad Entry Lock with Passage Feature and KABA L1021 Simplex Keypad Entry Lever Lock.

*Note: To install or remove the "Core" you will need a Schlage Control Key. Each lock combination (lock code) requires one (1) "Control Key".
Ex: If you order three (3) locks Keyed Different, you will need three (3) Control Keys. If you order three (3) locks Keyed Alike, you will only need one (1) Control Key.

Specifications: for Schlage Large Format I/C Core

  • Keyway: Standard 6 Pin "C" Keyway
  • Finish: Brushed Chrome

**Click here to order Schlage Control Keys, they are sold separately.
